Parliamentary Panel to Scrutinize FCRA Amendment Bill Amid Opposition Concerns

The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, has been referred to a 31-member joint committee of Parliament for scrutiny. This move follows concerns and pushback regarding the bill's proposed amendments. Opposition leaders, including Akhilesh Yadav, have labeled the bill as 'anti-minority'. Union Minister Kiren Rijiju challenged critics to provide proof for their claims. Several state-based organizations and religious groups, including the Andhra Pradesh Christian Leaders Forum and the Syro-Malabar Church, have also called for a review of the bill.
